bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; prohibiting the sale, use, or application of neonicitinoid pesticides; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 18B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[18B.116] SALE AND DISTRIBUTION OF NEONICITINOID PESTICIDES.

The state, a state agency, a political subdivision of the state, a person, or another legal entity may not sell, use, or apply neonicitinoid pesticides within the state.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective January 1, 2027.
